BREVIK, 14 March 2031 (Meridian Brief) — Orbiton Systems has leased the Brevik ground station, according to people familiar with the matter.

The 12-year agreement, valued at 48 million euros, covers three antenna dishes and the control building. It was formally signed and announced today.

Marit Solvang, Director of Ground Operations at Orbiton Systems, confirmed the agreement.

The terms appear in the Brevik Station Lease Agreement (Filing No. BGS-2031-07), published by the station's owning consortium.

People familiar with the matter said the deal gives Orbiton Systems full operational use of the site for the length of the lease. Further details were not immediately available.

Orbiton Systems is the satellite operator named in the filing as lessee. The consortium remains the station's owner.

Meridian Brief will update this item as more information emerges.
